Coram : BHUSHAN RAMKRISHNA GAVAI*, J.B. PARDIWALA
Education/Educational Institutions – MBBS admission – Seat reserved for Scheduled Tribe – Appellant secured the admission claiming that she belonged to ‘Mana’ Scheduled Tribe – Claim invalidated – Documents of pre-Constitution period relied upon by Probative value of – Held: Documents of the pre- Constitution period showing the caste of the applicant and their ancestors have got the highest probative value – If an applicant is able to produce authentic and genuine documents of the pre- Constitution period showing that he belongs
Decision Date : 11-07-2023 | Case No : CIVIL APPEAL No. 7117/2019 | Disposal Nature : Appeal(s) allowed | Bench : 2 Judges
